## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/combiner">Combiner</a> implementation.</p>


<p>This is per-function, so passes need to recreate one of these each time they enter a new function.</p>


<p>TODO: Is it worth making this module-wide?</p>
